# Regression: a single output{} with two targets must compile each target from
# the original checked IR, not the state left after lowering the previous target.
# Before ir.ClonePackage per target, the second target consumed already-lowered
# IR and produced corrupt/broken output.

sngl generate --out=out app.sngl

# Both targets produced their platform-appropriate output.
exists out/index.html
exists out/model.go

# html target: real DOM + client JS, not corrupted.
grep '<button id=' out/index.html
grep 'sngl \(html\)' out/index.html

# bubbletea target: real Go TUI code, not html-lowered leftovers.
grep 'package ui' out/model.go
grep 'charm.land/bubbletea' out/model.go
grep 'sngl \(bubbletea\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output {
    none { html }
    go { bubbletea }
}

component main {
    var count = 0
    button(text="inc", @click { count = count + 1 })
    text(value=string(count))
}
